
{{alias}}( x, n, b )
    Rounds a single-precision floating-point number to `n` significant figures
    in base `b`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x: number
        Input value.

    n: integer
        Number of significant figures. Must be greater than 0.

    b: integer
        Base. Must be greater than or equal to 2.

    Returns
    -------
    y: number
        Rounded value.

    Examples
    --------
    > var y = {{alias}}( 3.14159, 3, 10 )
    3.14
    > y = {{alias}}( 3.14159, 1, 10 )
    3.0
    > y = {{alias}}( 12368.0, 2, 10 )
    11999.999430030612
    > y = {{alias}}( -12368.0, 2, 10 )
    -11999.999430030612
    > y = {{alias}}( 0.0313, 2, 2 )
    0.03125

    See Also
    --------
